name: AFAS Profit
description: AFAS Profit — Dutch ERP and HR: read any published GetConnector, list what is available, and inspect a connector's metadata. Token auth with AFAS's base64-wrapped XML token.
instructions:
**AFAS exposes nothing until somebody publishes a GetConnector.** That is the whole model, and it is why this adapter takes the connector name as a parameter rather than hard-coding entity paths.
1. In AFAS open **Algemeen → Beheer → App connector** and create an app connector for the integration.
2. Add the **GetConnectors** the agent should reach (e.g. `Profit_Debiteuren`, `Profit_Facturen`, or your own `Custom_…`). A GetConnector that has not been added to the app connector does not exist as far as the API is concerned.
3. Generate the **token**. AFAS gives you an XML blob like `<token><version>1</version><data>ABC123…</data></token>`. Base64-encode that entire string and put the result in `AFAS_TOKEN`. AFAS's own UI offers a base64 version — use it.
4. Set `AFAS_ENVIRONMENT` to your environment id, the `O12345AB` code in your AFAS URL.

**The Authorization header is `AfasToken <base64>`**, AFAS's own scheme.

**Filtering uses three parallel parameters.** `filterfieldids`, `filtervalues` and `operatortypes` are comma-separated lists read positionally: `filterfieldids=Nummer,Datum`, `filtervalues=1001,2026-01-01`, `operatortypes=1,4`. Operator 1 is equals, 2 is greater-or-equal, 3 is less-or-equal, 4 is greater, 5 is less, 6 is 'is null', 7 is 'not null', 8 is not equal, 9 is 'starts with', 10 is 'contains'. Getting the three lists out of step produces a wrong answer rather than an error.

**`skip` and `take` page.** `take` is capped at 1000 and `-1` means everything, which on a large connector is not a good idea.

**UpdateConnectors are deliberately not exposed.** They write into AFAS with the full force of the business logic behind them, and a malformed payload is not something to discover from an agent.

**Unverified.** The paths and field names below follow the vendor's published documentation and have not been exercised against a live tenant. Treat a 404 as a docs-versus-reality gap and check the developer portal before concluding that the credential is wrong. A correction from anyone running this against a real system is genuinely welcome.

tools.name: afas_profit_list_connectors
tools.description: List the GetConnectors and UpdateConnectors published to this app connector. Start here: anything not in this list does not exist as far as the API is concerned.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_connector_metadata
tools.description: Read one GetConnector's field definitions: the field ids, their types and lengths. You need the field ids before any filter will work.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_data
tools.description: Read rows from a GetConnector with AFAS's positional three-list filter. filterfieldids, filtervalues and operatortypes are read in parallel — keep them in step.

filterfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to filter on, e.g. Nummer,Datum.

filtervalues.description: Comma-separated values, positionally matched to filterfieldids.

operatortypes.description: Comma-separated operators, positionally matched. 1 eq, 2 ge, 3 le, 4 gt, 5 lt, 6 is null, 7 not null, 8 ne, 9 starts with, 10 contains.

take.description: Rows to return, max 1000. -1 means everything.

orderbyfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to sort by; prefix with `-` for descending.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_debtors
tools.description: Read the Profit_Debiteuren GetConnector — customers with their debtor number, name, address and credit data. Only works if it has been published to your app connector.

filterfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to filter on.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_invoices
tools.description: Read the Profit_Facturen GetConnector — invoices with their number, date, debtor and amounts. Only works if it has been published to your app connector.

filterfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to filter on, e.g. Datum.

tools.name: afas_profit_get_employees
tools.description: Read the Profit_Medewerkers GetConnector — employees with their number, name, department and employment data. Only works if it has been published.

filterfieldids.description: Comma-separated field ids to filter on.
